title: Great Restaurants in Hoi An: 2026 Culinary Guide
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The 2026 Hoi An culinary guide, designed for post-golf dining after playing Hoiana Shores or Ba Na Hills, highlights 8 premier restaurants, including Tok Restaurant (Modern Fusion with rice paddy views) and Lim Dining Room (Authentic Italian in a heritage setting).
> *   Specific recommendations cater to diverse preferences: Com Linh for authentic local roast duck, The Surf & Turf Beach Club for beachfront steak and seafood, and La Table for sophisticated French bistro dining ideal for "Honor Roll" celebrations.
> *   Vietnamese cuisine is represented by Home Hoi An (refined, historical charm), Mango Rooms (Vietnamese Fusion by celebrity chef Duc Tran), and Morning Glory (traditional local food, bustling atmosphere).
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

**Hoi An Gastronomy: The 19th Hole Redefined**

When the final putt drops at **Hoiana Shores** or **Ba Na Hills**, the next critical decision for any golf trip is where to celebrate. In Hoi An, the 19th hole isn't restricted to a clubhouse; it extends into a UNESCO World Heritage town renowned for its culinary mastery.

At AGS, we bypass the standard tourist traps. We direct our groups to the hidden gems, heritage dining rooms, and chef-led kitchens that define the Central Coast's vibrant food scene. Here is our unfiltered guide to the greatest restaurants in Hoi An for 2026.

**Hoi An's Premier Dining: At a Glance**

| Restaurant | Cuisine | The Vibe | Best For |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Tok Restaurant** | Modern Fusion | Rice Paddy Views | Sunset dinners & innovative flavors. |
| **Lim Dining Room** | Authentic Italian | Heritage Setting | Elegant group dinners. |
| **Mango Rooms** | Vietnamese Fusion | Vibrant & Eclectic | A lively, colorful dining experience. |
| **The Surf & Turf Beach Club** | Steak & Seafood | Beachfront | Premium cuts with ocean views. |
| **Com Linh** | Local Roast Duck | High-Trust Local | Authentic, unpretentious Vietnamese. |
| **Home Hoi An** | Refined Vietnamese | Historical Charm | Immersive cultural connection. |
| **La Table** | French Bistro | Sophisticated | Celebratory "Honor Roll" dinners. |
| **Morning Glory** | Traditional Local | Bustling & Energetic | Experiencing Hoi An's staple dishes. |

**1\. Tok Restaurant**

Set against the tranquil backdrop of lush rice paddies, Tok Restaurant elevates dining into a scenic event. The modern fusion menu brings international finesse to local ingredients, making it an essential stop for those who appreciate culinary innovation after a day on the links.

![Tok Restaurant fusion dining Hoi An 2026](/images/restaurants-bars/vietnam/tok-fusion-dining.webp)

**2\. Lim Dining Room**

When your group craves authentic Italian food in a heritage setting, Lim Dining Room delivers. Nestled within Hoi An's Old Town, the restaurant combines old-world architecture with a menu of flawlessly executed Italian classics, offering a sophisticated contrast to traditional local fare.

![Lim Dining Room authentic Italian food heritage setting Hoi An 2026](/images/restaurants-bars/vietnam/lim-dining-room-authentic-italian-food-heritage-setting.webp)

**3\. Mango Rooms**

Helmed by celebrity chef Duc Tran, Mango Rooms is a vibrant explosion of color and flavor. The Vietnamese fusion dishes are as eclectic as the decor, providing a high-energy environment perfect for recounting the day's best shots over inventive cocktails.

![Mango Rooms celebrity chef Duc Tran restaurant Hoi An 2026](/images/restaurants-bars/vietnam/mango-room-celebrity-chef-duc-trans-restaurant.webp)

**4\. The Surf & Turf Beach Club**

For those staying in our private beachfront villas, The Surf & Turf Beach Club is the ultimate destination for premium cuts and ocean-fresh seafood. The beachfront dining experience perfectly mirrors the luxury of the Central Coast, making it a standout choice for an evening of indulgence.

![The Surf and Turf Beach Club amazing steak and seafood Hoi An 2026](/images/restaurants-bars/vietnam/surf-and-turf-club-amazing-steak-and-seafood.webp)

**5\. Com Linh**

For the golfer seeking the unfiltered reality of [Vietnam](/destinations/vietnam/), Com Linh is our top recommendation for traditional roast duck. This very popular duck restaurant is a high-trust local establishment where the focus is entirely on the exquisite, time-honored preparation of its signature dishes.

![Com Linh Vietnamese very popular duck restaurant Hoi An 2026](/images/restaurants-bars/vietnam/com-linh-vietnamese-very-popular-duck-restaurant.webp)

**6\. Home Hoi An**

Offering peerless Vietnamese cuisine in a beautifully restored setting, Home Hoi An captures the essence of the region's culinary heritage. The refined atmosphere and meticulous attention to detail make it an ideal venue for an elegant, culturally immersive dinner.

![Home Hoi An peerless Vietnamese cuisine Hoi An 2026](/images/restaurants-bars/vietnam/home-hoi-an-peerless-vietnamese-cuisine.webp)

**7\. La Table**

Bringing award-winning French cuisine to the heart of Vietnam, La Table operates with the precision of a Michelin-trained kitchen. The sophisticated bistro environment is our preferred recommendation for celebrating a tournament win or hosting a formal group dinner.

![La Table Hoi An award-winning French cuisine Hoi An 2026](/images/restaurants-bars/vietnam/la-table-hoi-an-award-winning-french-cuisine.webp)

**8\. Morning Glory**

A cornerstone of Hoi An's culinary landscape, Morning Glory is synonymous with traditional local food. The bustling energy and open kitchen format provide a taste extravaganza, ensuring you experience the foundational dishes that made Hoi An a global food destination.

![Morning Glory Vietnamese restaurant traditional local food Hoi An 2026](/images/restaurants-bars/vietnam/morning-glory-vietnamese-restaurant-traditional-local-food.webp)

**The AGS Verdict**

Hoi An’s dining scene is as compelling as its championship golf courses. Whether you prefer the heritage intimacy of Home Hoi An, the scenic innovation of Tok Restaurant, or a celebratory steak at The Surf & Turf Beach Club, the Central Coast delivers an unmatched culinary standard. When you travel with AGS, we handle the logistics, secure the best tables, and ensure your post-round experience is as memorable as your time on the fairways.

**FAQ: Dining in Hoi An**

**Q? What is the best restaurant for a large golf group?** 
A. Lim Dining Room and La Table both offer excellent environments for formal group dinners, while The Surf & Turf Beach Club is perfect for a relaxed, beachfront celebration.

**Q? Do these restaurants require advance booking?** 
A. Yes, especially during the peak golf season (February–September). AGS handles all reservations and logistical arrangements for your group.

**Q? Are there good options near the beachfront villas?** 
A. Absolutely. The Surf & Turf Beach Club is situated right along the An Bang / Cua Dai coastline, offering incredible dining just minutes from our luxury villa accommodations.

faqs.q: Which Hoi An restaurants are best for a celebratory golf group dinner?
faqs.a: Mango Mango (created by Chef Duc Tran overlooking the Japanese Bridge), Morning Glory Signature (elevated heritage Hoi An street classics in a colonial townhouse), and The DeckHouse at An Bang Beach are our top three picks for groups of 4 to 16 golfers.

faqs.q: How far in advance do Hoi An's top riverfront balcony tables book out?
faqs.a: Upper-floor riverfront balcony tables at Mango Mango, Cargo Club, and Morning Glory Signature book out 2 to 4 weeks ahead during the February–August peak golf season; Asia Golf Specialists locks in these tables alongside your tee sheet.

faqs.q: What are the three signature Hoi An dishes every golfer must try?
faqs.a: Every visitor to Hoi An should sample authentic Cao Lầu (chewy ash-lye noodles with char siu pork and crispy squares), White Rose dumplings (Bánh Bao Bánh Vạc translucent shrimp dumplings), and crispy Hoi An Bánh Mì from Phuong or Madam Khanh.
